rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges uncertainty from a single image, but likely overcalls ICM compactness and TE cohesion; the image appears somewhat collapsed/poorly defined, so calling it clearly strong A/A morphology is more confident than the image alone supports.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, endometriosis, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, sperm parameters, lining, BMI, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately tempered by age and endometriosis despite good morphology; only minor issue is confidence in image-based morphology relative to the actual visual quality.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET preference and caution about unproven add-ons; minor deviation is some speculative discussion of fresh vs freeze-all/endometriosis nuances without cycle-specific data.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support considerations, lifestyle advice, and contingency planning for failed transfer and future cycles, with appropriate nuance.
